Hi there! You can see the exact seat‑vs‑overage split right in the itemised view of your invoice.

1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices** and open the invoice you need.
2. Click the arrow to **expand each line item** – the seat charge line will break down the number of seats and the per‑seat rate, and any overage line will show the metered quantity that exceeded the plan’s allowance.
3. If you prefer a PDF, download it from the same page – the PDF contains the identical breakdown, so you can attach it to your budget review without sharing dashboard access.

This will give you the separate totals for seats and any usage overages instantly.

Let me know if you need anything else!
